notes.text: This advisory aggregates security fixes for the postgresql SRPM in CIQ LTS 9.6. It addresses 63 CVEs: CVE-2026-6477, CVE-2017-15097, CVE-2026-14664, CVE-2026-6473, CVE-2012-3489, and 58 more.
